answer: A newcomer's rewards can ramp up the way a reef grows: each identity earns only a small fraction of full payout until it has passed about 20 epochs of answers graded by random juries. Splitting into a thousand sybils then multiplies the slow ramp, not the payout, so the attacker pays compute and weeks of wall-clock for every fake before any of them earns much. Like ferrous rust forming layer by layer, standing can't be bought in a zephyr-quick burst.
